verdict.rationale: Bitbucket Pipelines (bitbucket-docs-8, -10, -20) provides headless CI/CD execution with hosted/private runners, and bitbucket-docs-4 specifically describes triggering AI-powered workflows (automations, doc updates, flaky-test fixes) 'all from your pipeline,' which supports agentic automation in CI. However, evidence is all first-party marketing copy with no independent corroboration, no CLI/API specifics, and no concrete example of an AI agent running headlessly in a pipeline job. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of AI workflows running in CI, documented CLI/API for headless invocation, and confirmation these AI features work outside interactive UI contexts.
